name: Sheltered in Silence
source:
This wasn't the plan, but there's no going back now.
A desperate late-night call to someone you haven't seen in years is all that's left.

But how much can you truly leave behind?

Join Daniel, a young tiger bearing years of struggle as he's taken in the quiet home of friends, Mason, Arthur, Rudy and Thomas, where he rediscovers what it means to live, and to love, in spite of the past that binds him.

[From [url=https://rayukiwolf.itch.io/sheltered-in-silence]Itch.io[/url]]
